description: Ranked ratings leaderboard — filter by band, score range, trend, or facet threshold. Sort by composite (default), delta (biggest gainers), or any quality facet (governance, security, …) to rank providers by that dimension. Each row also carries agent_readiness {score, band} and front_door_ai {band, band_label, score} — the two standalone layers, never part of the composite. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal, e.g. ["strong","exemplar"].

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

facet.description: Facet to threshold with min_facet: discoverability, contract_quality, contract_governance, operational_transparency, developer_ergonomics, access_clarity.

max_score.description: Only ratings at or below this composite. Pair with min_score for a range.

min_facet.description: Minimum score on `facet` (0-100); ignored without `facet`. E.g. 70.

providers.description: Restrict to these provider slugs — the ratings of a named set.

sort.description: Leaderboard order; default composite. agent_readiness and front_door_ai rank the two standalone layers; providers with no reading sort last.

tags.description: Tag slugs the provider carries, e.g. ["payments"].

trend.description: Week-over-week movement: "rising" (+5 or more), "falling" (-5 or more) or "flat" (within 5).

name: find_ratings
